observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow cooking gas cylinder with a top handle/guard and a valve area; the cylinder body has stickers/markings but the exact cylinder capacity marking is not clearly readable.

claims.evidence: The photos show cooking gas cylinders, but the capacity '12.5kg' is not clearly readable on the cylinder labels/markings in the provided images.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No test/certification document or leak-test evidence is shown in the photos.
The valve looks intact, but the photos do not provide proof it is 'new' (no date/receipt, and wear/age cannot be confirmed remotely).

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be another size), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity marking (e.g., '12.5kg') and serial/inspection markings, plus the valve label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used cooking gas cylinder with unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Leak status is unknown; a cylinder can appear fine but still leak at the valve/regulator connection.
risks.proof: A short video of a proper leak test (soap-water bubbles at valve/regulator connection) or a recent inspection/test slip showing leak test result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven leak-free (worst case: treat as needing inspection/possible leak).

risks.risk: Valve condition/compatibility is unknown (could be worn, mismatched thread/connection, or damaged internally).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve threads/connection face and a video showing the regulator fitting securely (no wobble) and then the flame test after connection.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as valve condition unverified (worst case: assume may require servicing/parts).

risks.risk: Cylinder age/condition and dents/rust affect safety and resale value.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the full cylinder body (including base ring and any dents), and the underside/base for corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with cosmetic wear visible.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo showing the cylinder capacity marking (confirm '12.5kg') and any stamped serial/inspection info.
Leak-test proof: either a recent inspection/test slip or a short video showing soap-water leak check at the valve/regulator connection.
Valve proof: close-up of valve connection/threads plus a video of regulator fitting correctly (no leaks during connection).
Full-body photos including the base/underside to assess dents/corrosion.
response.reason: The photos confirm the item type (cooking gas cylinder) but do not clearly verify the key pricing driver (12.5kg) and do not provide evidence for leak-free/certified status or that the valve is new. Without those, the correct worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
